title: 1991 AHSME Problem 9
statement: From time \(t=0\) to time \(t=1\) a population increased by \(i\%,\) and from time \(t=1\) to time \(t=2\) the population increased by \(j\%.\) Therefore, from time \(t=0\) to time \(t=2\) the population increased by

solutions.text:
The combined growth factor is \[ \begin{aligned} &\left(1+\frac{i}{100}\right) \left(1+\frac{j}{100}\right)\\ &\qquad=1+\frac{i+j}{100} +\frac{ij}{10000}. \end{aligned} \] Hence the percent increase is \(i+j+\frac{ij}{100}.\)

Thus the correct answer is D.
